GET the page (capture __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION), POST __EVENTTARGET=ddlPolicyCategory value 3 (SIMULTANEOUS LOAN & OWNERS), POST __EVENTTARGET=ddlPolicyType1 value 13615 (BASIC OWNER POLICY), POST __EVENTTARGET=ddlPolicyType2 value 13621 (SIMULT LOAN), then POST __EVENTTARGET=btnCalculate with txtLiabilityAmt=500000, txtCrLiabilityAmt=400000.
